description: Run a telegram CLI command that sends, edits, deletes or changes something (or saves files: download, sync), e.g. ["send","@user","-"] with stdin as the text. Needs write access, which only the user can enable (`telegram write-access on`). Writes need an ID, @username or exact chat title.

stdin.description: Text for a "-" argument (message body), avoids quoting issues

name: telegram_write
title: Write to Telegram
